summary: Bulk update capital planning forecasting fields
description: Applies one set of forecasting fields (planned start date, planned end date, curve) to many projects at once. Targets either an explicit list of project ids or every project matching a filter query minus exclusions. Partial success: projects failing validation are skipped and reported in the response rather than failing the request.

200.description: Counts of updated projects plus per-project failures

updated_count.description: Projects whose capital plan data was written. Excludes a project whose only requested change was a skipped `budget_type` (see `budget_type.skipped`).

failed_count.description: Projects skipped because they failed validation. See `failures`.

concept_project_count.description: Subset of `updated_count` that are concept-stage projects. Reported so the client can attribute bulk edits without a second read.

failures.description: One entry per skipped project. Empty when every target succeeded.

budget_type.description: Outcome of the `budget_type` change. Omitted when `budget_type` was not requested.

422.description: Selection exceeds the maximum number of projects per request

503.description: The permission check could not be completed (`AUTHORIZATION_UNAVAILABLE`) — safe to retry

all.description: When true, target every project matching the query below, minus excluded_ids.

ids.description: Procore project ids to update. Required unless `all` is true; ignored when `all` is true.

excluded_ids.description: Procore project ids to exclude. Only meaningful when `all` is true.

program_ids.description: Restrict the selection to these programs. Use "none" for projects with no program. Omit for company-wide. Only used when `all` is true.

portfolio_program_uuid.description: Restrict the selection to projects directly under this portfolio program node (descendants excluded), as `GET /projects` `portfolio_program_uuid`. Use "none" for projects with no node (or a node no...

search.description: Name/number search applied to the selection. Only used when `all` is true.

filters.description: Narrows the selection. Only used when `all` is true.

line_item_names.description: Seeded line item name, keyed by the type before the switch. Required with `multiple_line_items`; ignored otherwise.
